The user wants the editor to remember the cursor position, open files, and sidebar panel states when reopening a previously opened project.
This is a "session persistence" or "workspace state restoration" feature.
The anchor mentions:
1. Cursor position
2. Open files (tabs)
3. Sidebar panels (visible/closed)

Looking at the `plano`:
- `app`: `workspace_session`, `editor_tabs`, `workspace_detect`
- `editor`: `cursor_history`, `editor_buffer_source`
- `ui`: `busy_strip`, `bindings_store` (maybe panels?)
